'''Spinner's Web ''' was a criminal and anarchist gang on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] during the time of [[Hilts Restoration]]. They were led by [[Parlan Spinner]], the descendant of the ancient [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Lost Tribe]] outcast [[Ermon Parrah]]. In [[2974 BBY]], all members of Spinner's Web with the exception of Spinner himself were killed following a failed assassination attempt on the [[Grand Lord]] [[Varner Hilts]] at the Sith capital of [[Tahv]].
